name: Get Professional Certification
description: Structured workflow for selecting, preparing for, and passing a professional certification exam. Covers choosing the right certification for your career goals, building a study plan with spaced repetition, intensive exam preparation, test-day execution, and maintaining the certification with continuing education. Use when the user wants to get professional certification or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
